badgeText: VERSION 9.0: PROCEDURAL CHARTS + HUD STUDIOS + BATCH COMPOSITION!
title: Sumair Tools Cyber Suite v9.0

⏱️ Reel & Short Progress Bars: Story-style progressive segmented bars & linear progress rigs with active comp tracking
🏷️ Batch Layer & Comp Renamer Pro: Ad Hook formula sequencer with real-time preview and Project Bin source comp synchronization
📱 UI Safe-Zone Guides: Non-rendering wireframe overlay guides for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts
🖤 Total Obsidian Dark Mode: Pure minimal dark theme with crisp typography and neutralized white buttons
🍎 1-Click macOS Automated Installer with direct Unix permissions & cfprefsd cache flush
